title: Behavioral Health Screening Graph Model
description: Compare scored behavioral-health screening paths with structurally separate neurodiversity and palliative-care branches.
creator: Modeling Healthcare Data with Graphs
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Healthcare graph modeling
Behavioral health screening
chapter_title: Specialty Care, Surgery, and Remote Monitoring

learningObjectives: Differentiate scored screening paths from unscored neurodiversity and palliative-care branches, and classify each instrument by its screening target.

pedagogical.interactionPattern: Comparison through node and edge inspection
pedagogical.rationale: Cluster comparison and selective inspection provide direct evidence for classifying the different graph structures.
pedagogical.assessment: Classify the instruments and cite visible features that distinguish scored and unscored relationships.
